## Use this capability when the user means

- figure out what capital or funding path fits my business
- identify founder readiness gaps before raising money
- research realistic capital options for my business
- prepare a bounded capital-fit brief

## Authority

public offer discovery and human-confirmed paid research checkout

## Boundaries

- does not make lending or investment decisions
- does not guarantee financing
- checkout creation is not payment proof

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
